name: Cauliflower Cheese Bake
ingredients: 30 g low-fat cheese, grated, plus 1 tbsp nutritional yeast
½ tsp black pepper and a pinch of nutmeg
steps: Steam the cauliflower for 6 minutes; arrange in a baking dish.
Blend the beans with the soy milk, cornflour, mustard, garlic, nutritional yeast, nutmeg and seasoning until smooth.
Heat the sauce in a pan for 4 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Pour over the cauliflower and top with the cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
note: The white sauce is made from blended beans rather than butter and flour, adding fibre and protein.
